export const discount = (price, comparePrice) => {
  const p = Number(price);
  const c = Number(comparePrice);
  if (!Number.isFinite(p) || !Number.isFinite(c) || c <= 0 || p >= c) return 0;
  return Math.round((c - p) / c * 100);
};
